notable_absence.finding: None - this is a complete, well-structured reference page with introduction, provisioning methods, a configuration-structure example, a field table, a worked curl example, and a dedicated schema/model subsection. Its depth contrasts sharply with configuration-schema-access-control.json's near-empty stub for the analogous Sync Function/Access Control mechanism (see that record's cross_component_finding).

cross_component_finding: The scope/collection version-gating on this page (sgw:custom-scope/sgw:custom-collection availableSince version:sgw-3-1 and version:cbl-3-1) is new version-pairing information not present on configuration-schema-database.json's own 'Understanding Buckets, Scopes, and Collections' section, which describes the 1-scope/1000-collection limits and the CBS/SGW/CBL name-matching rule but never states a minimum version for the feature at all. Reading both pages together is required to get the complete picture: database.md for the mechanism and its limits, this page for when it became available and what to do if the client is newer than the server.
cross_product_finding: sgw:custom-collection mustUseInsteadWhen server:default-collection is a genuine cross-product compatibility rule spanning three products at once: a Couchbase Lite 3.1+ client, a pre-3.1 Sync Gateway or Capella App Services server, and Couchbase Server's own default-collection concept as the fallback keyspace both sides can agree on.
